title: Television - Status Monitoring and Diagnostics Protocol
scope: This standard defines the status monitoring and diagnostics protocol (SMDP) used with a general-purpose communication link that connects to equipment used in the production, post-production, and/or transmission of visual and audio information. The communication link is separate and distinct from the supervisory interface for digital control (ANSI/SMPTE 207M). SMDP may be used when querying equipment for status and diagnostics information.
